title: evaluator/frameworks.json
description: The installed frameworks a command evaluator depends on (Story 1.44, AD-21): per framework its package, the one exact version expected and a version probe, a tracked executable under evaluator/ that prints { package, version } for the installed package. An evaluator with no installed framework dependency declares an empty list. tea-evaluate check refuses a declaration off this schema and run observes each installed version through its probe. The tea-evaluate runtime owns this schema.

version.description: One exact version starting with a digit: no tag, range, wildcard segment, space or backtick.
